_comment: Posts that must never appear in the homepage Instagram carousel.
This is the MANUAL override. The automatic rule lives in
src/lib/instagram.ts: a reel the Graph API reports as reels-tab-only
(is_shared_to_feed: false) is hidden without anything being listed here.
Use this file for the other case — a post that IS on your feed but that
you do not want in the carousel.
TO HIDE A POST: open it on Instagram, tap Copy link, and paste the
shortcode — the part after /reel/ or /p/ — into `shortcodes` below.
The Instagram sync NEVER writes this file, so nothing here is lost when
the feed refreshes four times a day. Entries for posts that have since
aged out of the 50-post window are harmless — leave them or tidy them up.
`notes` is free-form and ignored by the code; it is there so a shortcode
in a diff still means something in six months.
